examples.text: „[Er] ſchied dahin, am Ende und Anfang ehrenvollen Berufes vom langſamen Siechthum ergriffen und ſchoͤnen Hoffnungen entriſſen; […]“ [1838]
„Menschen, zumal vertraute Menschen, dahinscheiden zu sehen, ist immer etwas sehr, sehr Schmerzhaftes, Trauriges.“
„Jeder Tod führt zu neuem Leben. Kaum ist einer dahingeschieden, ist schon wieder einer auf der Welt.“

translations.source_sense_description: intransitiv: aufhören zu leben und sterben

examples.text:
So should that beauty which you hold in lease
Find no determination: then you were
Yourself again after yourself's decease […]
I thought about my predecessor, who had died of drink and smoke; and I could have wished he had been so good as to live, and not bother me with his decease.
After which usurped victorie, he presently deceased: and partly through the excessive joy he thereby conceived.
